reason: The description accurately captures all core behaviors: the channel-based streaming approach with a buffer of 5, the goroutine that produces 10 articles asynchronously, the article fields (ID, title, data list, auth secret), the API version switch on `api.version` context key covering v1/v2/default-v3, the 100ms delay between items, closing the channel after all items, and delegating the actual response writing to `render.Respond`. The only minor omission is the channel buffer size of 5 (described as 'up to 10 articles' which is technically the count, not the buffer), but this is a secondary implementation detail that doesn't affect functional correctness.
missing_functionality: Channel buffer size is 5, not implicitly 10 — the description says 'up to 10 articles' which conflates item count with buffer capacity
incorrect_or_misleading_points: Saying 'up to 10 articles over time' is slightly ambiguous — it always produces exactly 10 articles, not a variable number
